05__Python__HotkeyManagers/Py__HotkeyMan.name: Auto Email (Vale Templates)
05__Python__HotkeyManagers/Py__HotkeyMan.description: AutoHotkey-style triggers that paste pre-built Vale delivery and project-sharing emails.

05__Python__HotkeyManagers/Py__HotkeyMan.name: Vale Typing Shorthand
05__Python__HotkeyManagers/Py__HotkeyMan.description: System-tray hotstring engine that expands typed shortcuts into Markdown-backed snippets.

10__Python__WinFileSystemTools/Py_FileUt.name: Standard Archival Compressor
10__Python__WinFileSystemTools/Py_FileUt.description: One-click archiver - zips a chosen folder using the standard Vale archival profile for long-term storage.

10__Python__WinFileSystemTools/Py_FileUt.name: List Files in Folder
10__Python__WinFileSystemTools/Py_FileUt.description: Dumps every file (with size) from a chosen folder into a timestamped .txt report.

10__Python__WinFileSystemTools/Py_FileUt.name: List Subfolders
10__Python__WinFileSystemTools/Py_FileUt.description: Dumps every direct subfolder name at the chosen directory level into a .txt report.

10__Python__WinFileSystemTools/Py_WinUti.name: Build Vale Project Structure
10__Python__WinFileSystemTools/Py_WinUti.description: Scaffolds the canonical Vale project folder tree for a new job at the chosen location.

10__Python__WinFileSystemTools/Py_WinUti.name: Project File Tree Viewer
10__Python__WinFileSystemTools/Py_WinUti.description: Interactive tree browser with high-quality image export of a project's directory structure.

20__Python__PDFTools/Py_PdfUtils__A3PdfD.name: PDF Doc Compiler (A3)
20__Python__PDFTools/Py_PdfUtils__A3PdfD.description: Merges multiple PDFs into a single A3 document with consistent page sizing and ordering.

20__Python__PDFTools/Py_PdfUtils__Compre.name: Compress PDF
20__Python__PDFTools/Py_PdfUtils__Compre.description: Shrinks a PDF's file size by re-encoding embedded images while keeping text crisp.

20__Python__PDFTools/Py_PdfUtils__HtmlTo.name: HTML to Pageless PDF
20__Python__PDFTools/Py_PdfUtils__HtmlTo.description: Renders an HTML file or URL into a single long pageless PDF - ideal for web captures.

20__Python__PDFTools/Py_PdfUtils__PdfToD.name: PDF to DXF
20__Python__PDFTools/Py_PdfUtils__PdfToD.description: Converts vector PDF drawings into DXF files ready for CAD consumption.

20__Python__PDFTools/Py_PdfUtils__PdfToP.description: Rasterises every page of a PDF into individual PNG images at a chosen DPI.

20__Python__PDFTools/Py_PdfUtils__PdfToT.name: PDF to Text Extractor
20__Python__PDFTools/Py_PdfUtils__PdfToT.description: Extracts embedded text or OCRs scanned PDFs and saves a structured Markdown file.

20__Python__PDFTools/Py_PdfUtils__PngToP.name: PNG to PDF
20__Python__PDFTools/Py_PdfUtils__PngToP.description: Compiles a batch of PNG images into a single ordered PDF document.

30__Python__ImageTools/Py_ImgUtils__Heic.name: HEIC to PNG
30__Python__ImageTools/Py_ImgUtils__Heic.description: Batch-converts Apple HEIC photos into PNG files, preserving image quality.

30__Python__ImageTools/Py_ImgUtils__Phot.name: Photo Metadata Purger
30__Python__ImageTools/Py_ImgUtils__Phot.description: Strips EXIF and other metadata from a batch of photos for safe public sharing.

50__Python__VideoTools/Py_VideoUtils__Co.name: Combine Videos (Chronological)
50__Python__VideoTools/Py_VideoUtils__Co.description: Stitches multiple video files into one output, ordered by original capture date.

50__Python__VideoTools/Py_VideoUtils__Pn.name: PNG Frames to Timelapse
50__Python__VideoTools/Py_VideoUtils__Pn.description: Turns a folder of numbered PNG stills into a smooth MP4 timelapse video.
